current_flow: sap-ingestion ingests the SAP Base Report (Excel) and the MIS budget into the separate warehouse Postgres: raw sap_transaction lines + a paise-precise actual_by_key_month gold view + a separate mis_budget object + an immutable ingest_batch registry, idempotent per-period, July DUB reconciling to ₹11,512,712.07. Per the client, the PoC uses the provided Excel workbooks directly with NO governed mapping master or derived allocation. Four tasks: warehouse-schema → actuals-loader → budget-loader → reconciliation-proof; the query-time join and drill-down stay out (0004).
new_abstractions: the warehouse write pool + ingestion repository (distinct from the read-only query port)
the ingest_batch immutable registry with a one-active-per-(kind,period,plant) pointer
sap_transaction raw lines + the actual_by_key_month paise gold view
the mis_budget separate object (as-provided, no allocation)
the POST /api/ingest/* endpoints + the new 'ingest' RBAC grant
gaps: The reconciliation target is factually impossible as an integer: the DUB raw rows total ₹11,512,712.07 (paise); integer equality across raw and gold cannot hold

The mapping task promises data that does not exist: Sheet1 has none of the 7 'missing' GLs, and even adding them leaves 11 DUB rows unmapped (50001902/50001903 cost-center conflict), so under reject-on-unmapped the July DUB batch cannot become a mapped/reportable active batch

A balanced budget allocation cannot be derived from either workbook (no MIS line id/period/amount/weight; repeated GLs, no cost centers) — inferring it would invent financial meaning and fan out the budget

The batch model cannot meet the settled replacement semantics: a 31-plant file vs ingest_batch(period,plant), no batch/version/active relation on budget, undefined active-pointer cardinality / locking / rejected-batch retention
There is no valid write path to the warehouse: the Warehouse port + PostgresAdapter are read-only (EXPLAIN/SELECT); Compose only creates a fixture; there is no warehouse migration command
The plan silently changed the settled statement proof to 'scoped total'; no statement exists until the later mis-statement story

Task order/ownership muddled: actuals-loader precedes the mapping needed to accept a period, and it registers a semantic domain (governed-joins' concern) serving no ingestion criterion; a governed mapping master belongs to a later story

The upload API is under-specified/non-compliant: verb-first route, no budget-ingest mechanism, no typed multipart DTOs, no Swagger success/error/auth, no CSRF/forbidden tests, no structured logging, and no 'ingest' grant (existing grants are admin/save/pin only)

The input contract is not falsifiable: exact SAP headers/aliases, duplicate 'Comments' header, date/amount parsing, blank/invalid rules, .xlsx/size/row caps, and row-diagnostic privacy are unspecified

The target schema conflicts with the database standard unless justified: missing audit fields, explicit indexes/constraints, a money-precision policy, and an ambiguous view-vs-matview choice for actual_by_key_month

The plan is missing mandatory handover structure: no ## Decisions (reconciling active decisions) and no ## Surface Impact, and it leaves exceljs / sync-vs-worker / migration runner / API versioning / role model as silent defaults
resolutions: PRECISION corrected: preserve paise in raw + gold (numeric 18,2), reconcile the EXACT ₹11,512,712.07, and round only a displayed aggregate.

CLIENT SCOPE 'no master for the PoC': ingest the mapping DIRECTLY from the provided SAP Entries Mapping.xlsx (DUB-NUR→DUB) with coverage as-is — no governed mapping master. The raw+gold reconciliation is mapping-independent (Σ over raw DUB rows); unmapped rows are retained raw, and mapped/reportable status is deferred to the mis-selection/governed-joins stories.
CLIENT SCOPE: load the MIS budget as-provided as a SEPARATE object (mis_budget), with NO derived allocation for the PoC; the balanced allocation is deferred to governed-joins.

BATCH model defined: ingest_batch(source_kind, period, canonical_plant, is_active, …) with exactly one active batch per (source_kind, period, canonical_plant); immutable raw/budget rows linked to a batch; replace = new batch switched active, prior retained.
WRITE path: warehouse-schema adds a warehouse write pool + ingestion repository (distinct from the read-only Warehouse query port) and a reproducible warehouse:migrate; the read seam is untouched.
STATEMENT proof: prove raw + gold + a FROZEN reconciliation fixture in this story; the later mis-statement story proves the same fixture at display level. This story asserts no statement total.

TASK order/ownership: 4 tasks warehouse-schema → actuals-loader → budget-loader → reconciliation-proof; no separate mapping-master task (folded into the loaders per the client); the semantic-domain registration is removed (governed-joins owns it).

API: POST /api/ingest/actuals and /budget with AuthGuard + a NEW 'ingest' RequireAction grant (added to grants.constants.ts + db/migrate seed + the route allow-list), typed multipart DTO + Swagger + CSRF/forbidden tests + structured logging; fresh endpoints owe full DTO compliance.

INPUT contract specified in actuals-loader: exact required headers (+ aliases, duplicate 'Comments' handling), single posting month per batch, date/amount parsing, blank/invalid rules with row diagnostics, .xlsx + size/row caps, and no-PII diagnostics; validate-all-before-write.

SCHEMA: fresh snake_case with created_at audit + explicit indexes/constraints + numeric(18,2) paise money precision; actual_by_key_month is a PLAIN VIEW over the active batch (no matview refresh) for PoC correctness.

HANDOVER: added ## Decisions (0002/0004/0008 + the PoC-no-master decision) and ## Surface Impact (API/data/ops/auth/docs/tests); named exceljs (the pre-committed ingestion lib), synchronous upload for the PoC (workers deferred), the warehouse:migrate runner, and the D-0008 demonstrated-evidence model.

rounds.question: Confirm the re-scoped sap-ingestion PoC plan: ingest directly from the two provided Excel workbooks with NO governed mapping master or derived budget allocation, narrowed to 4 tasks (warehouse-schema → actuals-loader → budget-loader → reconciliation-proof), reconciling July DUB to ₹11,512,712.07 (paise-exact). Proceed on this basis?
options: Yes — no master, use the Excel files (Rec.)

summary: One cold read of the drafted plan against the real fixtures returned eleven findings, six blocking. The two hardest (an incomplete mapping master and a non-derivable budget allocation) are dissolved by the client's decision to use the provided Excel workbooks directly with NO governed master for the PoC. A factual precision correction (₹11,512,712.07 paise), the statement→frozen-fixture proof scope, the missing warehouse write path + migrate, the batch/active-pointer model, the ingest API (typed DTO + Swagger + CSRF + a new 'ingest' grant), the falsifiable input contract, the schema conventions, and the ## Decisions/## Surface Impact handover are all resolved in the revised plan. Decomposition narrowed to four tasks. Verdict pass.
